thread:
maya: Heads up — CS opened an escalation: customer sees p99 latency jump to ~6s for /v1/generate in us-east-1 since 02:10 UTC. Request id 0x9f3a2e. They attached a sample curl and said it times out intermittently.

own: grabbing traces now. which model?

maya: redwood-small-1 (hosted). traffic ~120 rps for that org, usually p99 ~1.2s. No config changes on their side per CS.

samir: I see a correlated spike on infra metrics — queue depth on inference pool "hs-eu-east-1-s-2" jumped and GPUs look saturated on some nodes. Autoscaler didn't spin up new nodes for ~60s.

lina: deploy-bot reports a model reload at 02:06 UTC (v2026.02.06) in us-east that hit ~20% of capacity for a few minutes. Could be placement churn.

maya: Customer is asking for mitigation steps now. CS needs an ETA and a workaround.

own: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) route that org to a fallback model variant (redwood-small-1-quant) 2) enable circuit-breaker at 2s for that org 3) temporarily increase reserved capacity for dedicated pool handling hosted inference. Which is fastest?

samir: fastest = traffic split to fallback model variant (no infra change). I can push a per-tenant routing override to send 30% traffic to quant variant in ~3min. That will reduce tail.

lina: also can flip a routing policy to prefer eu-west region for that org — adds ~30–40ms network but reduces us-east pressure. Need to check compliance flag.

own: ok do quant fallback first. Samir — push 30% -> quant and monitor p95/p99. Maya — tell CS we have a temporary routing change and we'll follow up.

samir: doing it now. command: ``POST /admin/tenants/route-override
{ "org": "acme", "split": [{"model":"redwood-small-1-quant","pct":30},{"model":"redwood-small-1","pct":70}] }``

support-bot: Action accepted, override queued (id: ov-2026-273000-A).

lina: watch suggestion — enable circuit-breaker at 2s too; add header X-CB-ORG:acme to policy. That will prevent client-side retries amplifying queues.

own: I'll set CB to 2s for org acme.

samir: override applied. Early metrics -> p99 dropped from 6s -> ~2.4s on sampled traces. Queue depth decreased.

maya: sending update to CS: "We've routed 30% traffic to a lower-latency quantized variant and enabled a 2s circuit-breaker; initial telemetry shows p99 improving. We're keeping monitoring on and will follow-up with root cause and next steps."

support-bot: CS message posted to ticket INC-5423.

own: Next actions (post-mitigation): 1) correlate model reloads with placement churn (placement logs + k8s events) 2) tune autoscaler to react faster to queue spikes (scale-up threshold currently 60s) 3) add an SLO guardrail: per-tenant circuit-breaker and automatic fallback route at p99 > 2.5s for 5m 4) evaluate warm pool for that model in us-east.

samir: I'll capture placement logs and k8s events from 01:50–02:20 UTC, upload to runbook.

lina: I'll open a PR to add the guardrail rule to routing-controller and schedule a canary rollout.

own: good. Maya — confirm with CS we can keep the override until we finish RCA, suggest they test in eu-west fallback if they need immediate reliability.

maya: done. CS replied :thumbsup: — they want a postmortem and request we keep them updated about autoscaler changes.

samir: note for postmortem: include repro steps. curl example from customer:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-1","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":128}'
  --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 10 -v
```
add: attach trace id header X-Req-Id:0x9f3a2e.

own: ok locking this thread. If p99 creeps back up, escalate to infra and consider a fast rollback of v2026.02.06 deploy in us-east.

maya: closing loop with CS and adding to incident tracker INC-5423. Thanks all.
summary: mitigation: per-tenant routing override to quant variant + 2s circuit-breaker; follow-ups: autoscaler tuning, placement churn RCA, SLO guardrail PR
